blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transport group Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng Tsuper at Opereytor Nationwide (Piston) kicked off its two-day transport strike on Tuesday, calling on the government to halt the increase in fuel prices and provide jeepney drivers with “living wage.” Jeepney drivers and operators in some strike centers in Metro Manila—such as Novaliches, Sucat, Alabang, and Las Piñas—started their demonstrations around 6 a.m. on Tuesday. Piston said their protest also aims to demand that the government abolish the value-added tax and excise tax on fuel products, roll back fuel prices to P55 per liter, and repeal the Oil Deregulation Law, […]...
